description: Ten D030 landscape candidates pinned to native versions and checksums for unapproved reference comparison; v002 incorporates five repairs and the final plan requirements.
review_notice: Unapproved landscape candidates for comparison only. Candidate images are not art approval and do not update art/approved/. Producer reviews are recorded for the exact selected versions; one fresh independent exact-checksum review of all ten against the final plan is pending. Measured deviations remain disclosed per stanza. Stanza 10 has no supplied photo or caption; its reference panel explicitly records that absence and its scene derives from canonical Sanskrit alone. Portrait production is paused.
visual_review_status: Producer review only for the exact selected versions; fresh independent exact-checksum review is pending for all ten because the plan hash changed. See each row candidate_status and art/reviews producer reports. No art approval.

rows.scene: Bali is restored by Shukra’s rite and rules with power; distant Devas withdraw in fear. Keep the prior battle implied, not graphic.
rows.candidate_status: Producer uncertain: the side-on Bali foot has only three clear toe separations and Deva prayer digits overlap; five-toe anatomy and individual prayer digits are not fully countable. Skin-only human samples range R-B 62–122; Shukra’s upper arm is 122 but reads warm brown. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: Aditi grieves for her sons and seeks Kashyapa’s help; he instructs the twelve-day milk vow and worship.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Aditi and Kashyapa are distinct and naturally posed; sampled face R-B values are 128 and 114 and both read brown, not orange. Aditi’s prayer hands overlap in the pose but show no malformed digits; Kashyapa’s teaching hand is coherent. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: After the vow, the dark blue four-armed Lord appears before Aditi and tells her he will be born as her son. Exactly four attached arms.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Aditi skin R-B 113 and Vishnu face B-R 46; Aditi reads brown and Vishnu deep blue. Vishnu has four visibly attached arms and separate attributes, with five toes on each visible foot. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: Show the auspicious birth to Aditi on Dvadashi and Shravana; the child is the manifest divine form. Keep the moment intimate.
rows.candidate_status: Producer uncertain: four infant arms and two five-toed feet are visible; Aditi/Kashyapa face R-B values are 113/117. Infant face B-R is 41 but torso B-R is 15; Aditi’s supporting fingers partly overlap the infant’s legs. The small vertical forehead mark reads as Vaishnava iconography. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: A small distinct group of Devas showers flowers while Aditi and Kashyapa praise with joined hands; Vamana becomes a capable young brahmachari. Vamana has two arms.

reference.label: Original reference: photo 006 (both 005 and 006 map to #5)

rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: the two Deva flower-casting hands show a thumb plus four coherent fingers each; Vamana has two attached arms and five visible toes on each foot. Human face patches range R-B 103–118 and read brown; Vamana face B-R 91. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: Prajapatis perform Vamana’s initiation and offer sacred thread, staff, deer skin and prayer beads; after the fire rite he departs toward Bali’s Ashvamedha.
rows.candidate_status: Producer uncertain: Brahma now shows exactly four attached arms and hands, four total heads with three visible faces, and a modest ochre ornament. Kashyapa/sage skin R-B values are 116/111; Brahma is rose-ochre R-B 125 under his contract; Vamana B-R 79. The lower pot grip partly hides finger ends. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: The short brahmachari walks with umbrella and staff; the earth subtly trembles under his emerging divine gravity. Two arms, no Krishna feather or crown.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: one two-armed Vamana walks with umbrella and staff; both feet show five toes; face/torso patches are B-R 50/56 and read deep blue. No extra cast or Krishna feather/crown. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: Vamana arrives at the Hayamedha hall on the north bank of the Narmada. His presence dazzles Shukra and sages, who wonder whether he is Sun, Fire, Sanatkumara or a yogi.

reference.label: Original reference (caption/photo mismatch; canonical scene controls)

rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Shukra and three sages are visibly distinct; no repeated sage. Human skin patches range R-B 90–108; Vamana cheek B-R 99. Both Vamana feet show five toes. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: Bhrigus bring radiant Vamana to Bali’s hall. Bali welcomes him, washes both feet and receives that water reverently on his head.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: Bali’s basin washing and crown-receiving gesture are legible; Vamana’s feet show five toes each. Bali/sage skin R-B values are 103/101/93; Vamana B-R 84. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.

rows.scene: Canonical-only stanza: Bali’s Prahlada lineage and sacrifices explain his fortune in receiving the sacred water from the Lord’s foot, water cherished on Shiva’s head. Show Bali reverently receiving the water, with Shiva and Ganga as a restrained devotional echo.
rows.candidate_status: Producer pass: the stream visibly contacts Bali’s bowed crown before continuing to Shiva’s hair; both Vamana feet show five toes. Bali skin R-B 85, Vamana B-R 69 and Shiva blue-grey B-R 18. This stanza remains canonical-only with no photo/caption. Independent exact-checksum review against the final plan is pending.
